categories.name: Primocane-fruiting erect blackberries
categories.description: CSU describes primocane-fruiting erect blackberries as fruiting on new canes, making winter management easier because canes can be cut to the ground

categories.name: Semi-erect blackberries
categories.description: CSU describes semi-erect blackberries as thornless, vigorous, trellis-requiring plants that generally yield more than trailing or erect types

categories.name: Blackberry/red raspberry hybrids
categories.description: CSU says blackberry-red raspberry hybrids are usually natural crosses and are generally considered a type of blackberry because the receptacle comes off with the fruit
